Participating b idders/sellers must strictly adhere to each condition. Failure to comply will lead to summary technical disq ualification without any further notice or clarification.

PRINTING LANGUAGE: ENGLISH, HINDI, URDU & KASHMIRI. (Due to single Option, we couldn't add multiple languages in that list thus we added it here) ​1. Mandatory Submission of Physical Samples ​Venue for Submission: Bidders must physically deliver the required product samples to the Office of the Pri ncipal / Head of Institution, School Campus, on or before the official bid closing date and time during worki ng hours (10:00 AM to 4:00 PM). ​Identification & Labeling: Each sample must be securely packed and clearly marked with: ​GeM Bid Number & Date ​Name and Contact Information of the Participating Firm/Seller ​Item Name, Brand, Model, and Batch/Specification details ​Strict Cut-Off Window: No samples will be accepted or entertained under any circumstances after the bid e nd date and time. Courier delays, postal delays, transit disruptions, or technical issues will not be accepte d as valid grounds for late submission. ​2. Strict Compliance with Uploaded Technical Specifications ​Specification Benchmark: The submitted physical sample must strictly conform in all respects (dimensions, material grade, build quality, finish, technical parameters, and durability) to the specifications and scope of work provided in the uploaded bid document. ​Non-Conformity: Samples deviating from the uploaded tender specifications, standard safety norms, or aes thetic/durability requirements will be rejected immediately. ​Demonstration / Testing: The School Technical Evaluation Committee reserves the right to conduct functio nal, physical, or laboratory testing on the submitted samples to verify quality. ​3. Verification, Evaluation & Disqualification Rights ​Prerequisite for Technical Evaluation: Submission of the sample is a mandatory eligibility criterion. Technic al bids of sellers who fail to submit physical samples before the bid end date will not be evaluated and will be rejected outright at the technical qualification stage. ​Buyer's Discretion to Disqualify: The Buyer (School / Purchasing Authority) reserves the absolute right to re ject the sample and disqualify any participating seller/bidder whose: ​Physical sample does not match the specifications stipulated in the tender document. ​Workmanship, material grade, or finish is deemed substandard by the evaluation committee. ​Delivered sample does not correspond to the product literature uploaded with the bid. ​Finality of Decision: The assessment and findings of the School Inspection/Procurement Committee regardi ng sample suitability, compliance, and quality shall be final, conclusive, and binding on all participating bid ders. ​4. Documentation & Proof of Submission ​Receipt / Acknowledgment: Upon physical delivery of the sample at the school, bidders must obtain a sign ed and stamped Sample Delivery Acknowledgment Slip from the designated receiving official. ​Document Upload on GeM: Bidders must upload a scanned copy of this stamped acknowledgment slip alon g with their technical bid documents under the ATC document upload section on the GeM portal. Bids lacki ng this acknowledgment may be treated as non-responsive. ​5. Supply Alignment & Delivery Guarantees ​Matching Bulk Supply: If awarded the contract, the successful bidder must supply the final consignment in exact accordance with the approved sample. Any variance between the approved sample and the bulk sup ply will result in immediate rejection of the consignment at the seller's cost and risk. ​Sample Retention: The approved sample submitted by the successful bidder will be retained by the school

until final delivery and acceptance of the entire consignment for quality comparison.
